reason: #513 made chat.turn.completed hooks receive assistant_message (the answer the turn is about to store) on every completion path, which fixed operator Stop-hook ports that require it, but left the payload unbounded and undocumented: the starter hook's run.sh comment in guides.py (the only payload documentation) still listed only finish_reason and detail, and no test checked assistant_message on the routing-answer path (#501). _turn_end_hook_payload now bounds assistant_message to 64 KiB of UTF-8 (cut on a character boundary, the stored answer untouched) and adds assistant_message_truncated, false on every event including failed and cancelled, so all three turn ends keep one key set; the starter hook comment documents both keys. tests/v3/test_hook_assistant_message.py (5 tests, all fail on origin/main 8eced0a) covers the routing-answer completed hook with a guard hook that refuses a completion without a string answer, a 70,001-byte answer cut mid-character end to end, and the helper at, over and without the limit. The edited exact-payload tests in test_native_hook_turn_ends.py (4, fail on main for the new key) and the existing tests of the changed helper (#513's rejection and streaming-hold tests, the routing-answer hook test, the starter-files test) are selected by node id.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite) does not exercise native hook payload contents; the Python tests drive the hook runner directly. No full suites. test_chat.py, test_chat_tool_loop.py, test_native_hook_turn_ends.py, test_routing_prose_answer.py and test_guides.py were run in full locally (122 passed), plus the hook tests of test_chat_api.py and test_api.py (4 passed).
